problemSelected: The major_light_leak critical automatic-fail path had direct still references but lacked a mandatory current pixel-domain triage artifact bound to the real native-4K crop bytes. Source construction and lighting QA cannot prove that post-tonemap seams or holes are visually absent.
implementation: Added rendered_light_leak_diagnostics_contract.json with guarded bright-on-dark sampling, clustering, five canonical leak-sensitive crops, zero-point policy and non-authoritative warning semantics.

Added QualityBlockRenderedLightLeakDiagnostics.cs. Runtime analysis requires an actual Unity-produced 3840x2160 manifest, loads canonical 100% unresampled crops, measures bright centers against a dark annulus, clusters candidates in 32px blocks, records SHA-256 for manifest/crops, and emits warning-only triage.
Integrated contract validation and runtime analysis into QualityBlockNative4KReviewPacket after sealed still/temporal evidence generation.
Updated reviewed visual evidence integrity schema to 1.2 so the core score path requires a current SHA-256-bound light-leak report in addition to repetition and temporal runtime evidence.

Expanded major_light_leak observability from two crops to five: hero/facade_center, hero/ground_contact, oblique/construction_depth, oblique/balcony_services, grazing/material_grazing. Human review, not the heuristic, remains authoritative.
selfAudit: An intermediate edit introduced a stray source character in QualityBlockReviewedVisualEvidenceIntegrityQA.cs. It was corrected immediately in commit b8fc5b7934e521bb7bee405655042e341159a1e4, and the affected final source region was re-fetched after correction.

The light-leak detector is deliberately not an automatic FAIL rule because legitimate sun glints, reflective edges and true sky apertures can produce the same local bright-on-dark signal. Automatically deciding the critical defect from this heuristic would create false failures and encourage physically wrong suppression of highlights.
Zero warnings are explicitly insufficient to clear major_light_leak; scoring requires direct reviewed evidence across all five canonical crops.
No Unity compile/runtime result was available, so no render quality, no diagnostic measurements and no Visual Fidelity points are claimed.
